name: weekly
description: 科技爱好者周刊，每周五发布
one_liner: A weekly Chinese-language newsletter, published as plain text files on GitHub, curating interesting tech news and links.
buyer: No real buyer — this is a free personal newsletter archive with no product, service, or software to sell around it.
business_use_cases: A reader learns about weekly curation formats and starts their own niche newsletter in a different language or industry, inspired by its longevity and format.
A recruiter reads the linked 'who's hiring' issue threads for candidate sourcing leads.
A content aggregator scrapes it (with permission) as one source among many for a broader tech-news digest product.

money_ideas.idea: The author's own version already monetizes via sponsorships/donations, which isn't something to replicate as a new business — treat it as content, not a product.

steal_this: There's nothing here to build a business on; it's a personal reading list, not a tool or product. If anything, start your own weekly curated newsletter in a niche you know — but that's a content habit, not this repo.
